summary: First test run for BillBuster. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass (root, hsn, monthly-report, scan validation+persistence+no _id leak, scans list, delete, chat + history). Frontend: all 3 screens load, language toggle (EN/HI/MR) updates strings, navigation between Home → Scan/History/Help works, chat sends message and receives Claude reply. Expo tunnel was down on first attempt and required a supervisorctl restart expo to come up (ngrok flakiness).

ui_bugs.issue: Empty state and list do not have testIDs 'history-empty' / 'history-list' although the empty UI renders correctly ('No scans yet. Tap Scan Bill to start.')
Assistant/user chat message bubbles lack per-role testIDs (e.g. chat-msg-user / chat-msg-assistant). Functionally replies render on screen.

issues: Touch targets are good (>=44px). Language pill is compact but usable. Monthly risk card is readable. All strings switch on lang toggle.

react_native_issues.issue: expo-file-system@55.0.17 and expo-image-picker@55.0.19 are newer than expo SDK expected versions (warnings only, no runtime error observed on web).

action_items: Optional: add testIDs: scan-back-btn, history-empty, history-list, chat-msg-user, chat-msg-assistant for more robust future UI testing.
Monitor ngrok tunnel stability — expo service came up only after manual restart (tunnel errors visible in /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log). Not a code bug, but user may hit 502 on first load.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py validate_invoice correctly excludes mongo _id via insert_one(doc.copy()) and .find projection {'_id': 0}. Good.
Chat endpoint loads history but does not pass it into LlmChat — LlmChat manages context via session_id internally. History fetch result is unused; consider removing or using it.
No rate limiting on /api/scan and /api/chat (LLM cost risk). Consider adding.
ExtractedInvoice.vendor_gstin stripped then uppercased in extract_invoice_fields — good.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (correct pattern for Expo).
seed_data_creation: None. Tests clean up their own scans via DELETE /api/scans. Chat session ids prefixed TEST-.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://gst-validator-app.preview.emergentagent.com. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_billbuster.py covers all endpoints including real GPT-4o OCR and Claude chat via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. If expo returns 502, run: sudo supervisorctl restart expo (ngrok tunnel). Frontend uses testIDs: app-name, lang-{en|hi|mr}, lang-toggle, monthly-risk-card, monthly-risk-amount, scan-bill-btn, history-btn, help-btn, take-photo-btn, pick-gallery-btn, demo-btn, chat-input, chat-send-btn.
rca_of_issue: No functional issues found. Only concern: ngrok tunnel flakiness — expo supervisor logs show repeated 'CommandError: ngrok tunnel took too long to connect' and 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading body)'. Retries eventually succeed after restart.
